anti_patterns.name: Motivation-First Fix
anti_patterns.symptom: Responding to onboarding friction with a motivation/education campaign — even though it’s ability (simplicity of steps) that’s the problem.

anti_patterns.name: Gamification Mismatch
anti_patterns.symptom: Points/badges/leaderboard that don’t answer the customer’s itch — 'no amount of gamification will help'

anti_patterns.name: Forced Investment
anti_patterns.symptom: Meminta data/kerja/komitmen SEBELUM reward pertama — melanggar timing investasi (setelah reward, bukan sebelum)
